# Numerical references

The CSV references are copied from the independently validated R package's
cross-language tests. The `all_priors_*` files were generated by executing
the numerical definition cells of `experiments/simulations/Code_simulation.ipynb`,
not by this Python package. The metadata JSON records the source notebook
SHA256, library versions, random seed and null sample hashes.

The older `shifted_*` references supply one-sided Gaussian, Cauchy and Lebesgue
checks. Tests also compare selected directional mixtures with independent
SciPy noncentral-t integration, verify analytic Gaussian and Lebesgue
calibration formulas, and check mixture recombination and sign reflection.

The Monte Carlo `lower` and `upper` columns bracket a finite empirical mean.
They do not bracket the population calibration or account for sampling error.
